entries.title: MD0006 — dynamite blockage
entries.description: Plant dynamite beside the large stone blockage, wait for it to move away, then cross the opened passage.

entries.title: MD0006 — paired rubble passage
entries.description: One dynamite blast must activate both adjacent rubble piles and leave a traversable corridor.

entries.title: MD0008 — moving block carrier
entries.description: Use the visible moving block to reach the destination area without falling through it.
